parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad is a small plastic component located at the bottom front of the trashcan, designed to be pressed by foot.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator for the lid mechanism, allowing hands-free operation by pressing it with the foot.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a downward direction when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a flat, hinged plastic cover that seals the top of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and conceals the trash inside. It opens automatically when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge axis when actuated by the foot pedal mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the trashcan, made of durable plastic and designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and contains the trash bag or waste material.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed base for the lid and pedal mechanism.
